description: Dispatch an async query of Marketo sales person records (GET /rest/v1/salespersons.json) by filter_type and up to 300 filter_values. Pages internally at the vendor's 300-per-call ceiling up to 500 rows by default (5000 with acknowledge_default_limit_override plus row_limit). The finished job writes the records to output_tsv_path and reports truncated.
embedding_description: Query Marketo sales person (sales owner) records by a searchable field and up to 300 values. Async job pages through the vendor's nextPageToken and writes matching sales persons to a workspace TSV, with a truncated flag. Keyed by externalSalesPersonId (dedupe) or id. Distinct from describe_sales_persons, which returns the schema.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Marketo sales persons query job dispatched
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with job_id and status 'queued'. The completed job result (via check_marketo_job_status) is a TSV handle: path, columns, row_count, and truncated (true when more records may exist beyond the row limit).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the job was dispatched and give the job_id; the records are not available until check_marketo_job_status reports completed. Then state the TSV path and row_count and say plainly when truncated is true.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Read Marketo sales persons from the configured instance.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.invalid_params: refused at dispatch before any vendor call (missing or malformed parameters, more than 300 entries, an action/dedupe_by/delete_by value Marketo does not define, or an output_tsv_path outside saved locations). On the finished job: marketo.permission_denied (vendor 603 or HTTP 403) means the API user's Role lacks the Access API permission; marketo.auth_failed (601/602 after one re-mint, or HTTP 401) means the credential was rejected; marketo.validation_failed and other vendor codes carry Marketo's own message.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.permission_denied: grant Read-Only Sales Person (or Read-Write Sales Person) under Admin > Users & Roles > Roles > the API role > Access API, then retry. Adobe documents some Lead Database object APIs as unavailable on subscriptions with a native CRM sync; that vendor error is reported as returned.
